title: Data and Utilities
summary: This module provides tools for loading, processing, and managing various datasets for DSPy programs, along with general-purpose utilities for file management, asynchronous execution, and callback handling. It also includes tools for documentation generation.

nodes.label: Manage Datasets & Loading
nodes.title: Dataset Management & Loading
nodes.description: Provides tools for loading, processing, and managing various datasets for DSPy programs, including specialized datasets like AlfWorld, GSM8K, and MATH, and utilities for data splitting and sampling.

nodes.label: Provide General Utilities
nodes.title: General Utility Functions
nodes.description: Offers a collection of general-purpose utilities for file downloading, asynchronous program execution, callback management for both synchronous and asynchronous operations, and adapting asynchronous modules for synchronous use.

nodes.label: Generate Documentation
nodes.title: Documentation Generation Utilities
nodes.description: Provides various utilities for generating and enhancing documentation, including scripts for API reference creation, MkDocs navigation updates, and a client-side feature to copy page content as Markdown. It also includes a script for generating synthetic data for tutorials.

groups.label: Data Management
groups.title: Data Management & Processing
groups.description: Focuses on loading, processing, and managing datasets for DSPy programs, including specialized datasets and data splitting functionalities.

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: General-Purpose Utilities
groups.description: Contains essential helper functions for common tasks like file handling, asynchronous execution, and callback management, supporting various DSPy operations.

groups.label: Documentation Support
groups.title: Documentation Generation & Enhancement
groups.description: Provides tools and scripts for automating documentation generation, updating site navigation, and enhancing the user experience of the DSPy documentation.
